# Welcome to my website!

My name is Mallory Bergmann and I am a graduate student at Case Western Reserve University. I am studying Systems Biology and Bioinformatics in pursuit of my Master of Science (MS). I am new to the bioinformatics field, as my undergraduate studies were more traditionally biology based, but having background in Genomics brought me to the field where I hope to join these topics in research. This personal website highlights my background, experiences, and projects/publications.

My current research is explored in the field of cancer sciences, which I aim to refine a thesis and continue this project throughout my graduate studies. 

In my free time I enjoy practicing yoga, going to concerts, and spending time with friends and family.

On this website, you will find a selection of my published works, current projects, and updates on my academic and professional progress.
Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:mail.mcb242@case.edu) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential projects.
